policy: Armenia is greenfield and has no incumbent dataset, so parity, export_surface, and target_surface are deliberately absent. Public Armenian administrative and raw-survey margins govern the direct-column pool reweight; national accounts will provide broad macro backstops. CEQ and World Bank studies remain documented external validation-band candidates rather than gates until their facts are harvested into Ledger.

gates.not_applicable: Chronicle has not yet supplied the target cell inventory, covariance, or steward-reviewed Armenia within/share thresholds. Shared runner defaults and Belgium's policy numbers may not silently govern Armenia.
gates.notes: Activate with explicit country policy after the target harvest; fit must be reported separately for every hard family so no family hides in an average.

gates.not_applicable: The ledger-am facts, their uncertainty, and reviewed fact-specific tolerances do not exist yet. The generic runner fallback and Belgium's tolerance are not Armenia policy.
gates.notes: Activate at country and marz level when every hard reference resolves. Consume leaf components or their total, never both as independent objectives.

gates.not_applicable: The 2022 assignment distribution and complete 71-community code roster are harvest items, and the shared operator is not yet bound.
gates.notes: Community diagnostics remain non-blocking until the spine demonstrates adequate support (populace#263).
The active profile must retain every engine-free v1 calibration family. National-accounts rows are validation-only and therefore are not counted as hard calibration coverage.

gates.not_applicable: The 2024 ArmStat SNA quantities, direct candidate metrics in destination units, analyst-reviewed concept bridges, and low/high Armenia band endpoints are all harvest or policy-review items. The supplied 26.9 percent survey-to-macro observation is validation evidence, not an invented acceptance band.
gates.notes: Activate named household-consumption and household-income bands once their evidence is reviewable. They remain broad backstops, never solver objectives.
Every direct or deterministically transformed measure must carry its authenticated donor range; an absent support receipt cannot release.
Every production fit and reweight step must receipt its resolved weight kind; silent unweighting is forbidden.
No all-zero stored calibration layer or provenance banner may ship.
The source manifest owns the physically non-negative direct and indicator column list.

gates.not_applicable: The vocabulary exists, but its current evaluator/binding is UK-specific and no ex-ante reviewed Armenia ESS threshold has been supplied. Promote a shared binding and record the threshold before runtime activation.
gates.notes: An explicit receipt is preferable to inventing an Armenia threshold.

gates.not_applicable: The vocabulary exists, but its current evaluator/binding is UK-specific and no ex-ante reviewed Armenia max-to-median threshold has been supplied. Promote a shared binding and record the threshold before runtime activation.
gates.notes: Never set the cap from the candidate merely to make a release pass, and do not copy the empirical UK fence.
